Case Study Effects Co. browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Case Study Germanium Aspen Overdrive Published on September 28, 2025 Case Study Effects Co. overdrive pedal Information The Case Study Effects Germanium Aspen is a Custom Shop reimagining of the Aspen overdrive pedal, distinguished by its use of rare germanium diodes in place of the standard silicon clipping stage. These diodes transform the pedal's response, producing softer clipping, smoother highs, and an organic liveliness that silicon cannot replicate. The design originated when a small stash of germanium diodes was tested in the Aspen circuit, immediately yielding a unique and inspiring sound. Initially only five units were built, with four given to close friends, but a later discovery of another limited batch of diodes allowed for a small public release. At its core, the Germanium Aspen retains the foundation of the standard Aspen, a versatile overdrive capable of everything from clean boost to saturated distortion bordering on fuzz. It incorporates thoughtful circuit refinements, including a post-drive volume control for managing output levels more effectively, a bass knob for precise low-frequency shaping, and two toggle switches for additional tonal flexibility. Each unit is hand-built with through-hole components, avoiding surface-mount construction, and production remains extremely limited due to the scarcity of suitable germanium parts. Visually, this Custom Shop edition is set apart with an exclusive Midnight Black finish accented by Mocha control knobs. Its rarity, handmade construction, and germanium-driven tonal character make it a distinctive addition to the Aspen lineage, blending classic inspiration with unique sonic depth. Controls Gain: Adjusts the drive intensity, ranging from subtle boost and light overdrive to heavy saturation and fuzz-like textures. Tone: Shapes the overall brightness of the sound, reducing treble content when lowered or adding presence and bite when raised. Volume: A post-drive output control that balances and levels the signal after the clipping stage, ensuring flexible integration with any rig. Bass: Provides dedicated low-frequency adjustment, from tight, controlled bass to fuller, weightier low-end response. SW1 Toggle: Selects an alternate
